# Chat/RAG Requirements Quality Checklist: P-RF04 — Interactive chat with memory (RAG)

**Purpose**: Pre-implementation requirements-quality review covering RF04's four main requirement clusters — streaming/failure/retry state machine, offline & connectivity behavior, side menu sessions (list/pagination/titling), and RAG grounding & persistence semantics — ahead of `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for an SSE connection that fails to establish at all (before `message_created`), as distinct from a mid-stream drop? [Gap, Spec §FR-004/FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the behavior specified for a retry request that itself returns an immediate non-streaming error (e.g., 4xx) before any streaming begins? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the composer/UI shows between the user tapping send and the lazily-created session's `POST /chat/sessions` response arriving? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is there a requirement for what the side menu shows while the first page of `GET /chat/sessions` is still loading (empty state vs. loading indicator)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the local cache's retention limits (if any) across previously-opened conversations, or is unbounded retention an implicit assumption? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a requirement defined for the case where `POST /chat/sessions` succeeds but the following first-message send fails, leaving a session that exists with no messages? [Gap, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "most recent activity" (`lastUserMessageAt`) ordering unambiguous for two sessions sharing an identical timestamp, so side-menu/pagination order is stable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "short, trimmed preview" title-derivation rule (length, truncation boundary, whitespace handling) specified precisely enough for two implementers to produce identical output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "near the backend's maximum length" in the message-length edge case quantified with the actual numeric limit the client must enforce or detect? [Clarity, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the "standard no-connection state" shown for a never-cached conversation (FR-011, Edge Cases) specified with enough detail to distinguish it from the offline banner shown over a cached conversation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do FR-007 (single-flight gating per conversation) and FR-012 (block create/send/retry while offline) combine consistently for the case of being offline while a response is already in flight for that same conversation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007/§FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the terminal-state vocabulary in FR-004 ("complete response" / "Falha ao gerar resposta") consistent with the Key Entities section's "still arriving, complete, or failed" status language? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the offline-cache scope in FR-011 ("every previously-opened conversation") fully reconciled with the Edge Cases statement about a never-opened conversation, leaving no undefined partially-cached state in between? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "Novo Chat"'s behavior while offline (FR-009) consistent with FR-010's lazy-creation model and FR-012's block-on-offline rule, or does the spec leave an implicit third case unaddressed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009/§FR-010/§FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001's "100% of tested cases" be objectively verified without a documented minimum sample size or seeding procedure? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-004's "zero observed duplicates" across "repeated retries" measurable without the spec specifying how many repeated retries constitute a sufficient test? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-006's "re-enabling within one interaction of connectivity returning" define what counts as "one interaction" precisely enough to be testable (e.g., does a passive reconnect count, or only a user-initiated retry)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Does SC-007 define a specific session-count threshold used to verify "remains reachable by scrolling," or is the test condition left to the reviewer's discretion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for retrying a message that failed mid-stream (partial text present) versus one that failed before any token arrived — is the retry-triggering UI treatment specified as identical in both cases? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Is single-flight gating (FR-007) explicitly scoped to "per conversation," with a requirement covering whether a user can send in a different, idle conversation while another conversation's response is still in flight? [Clarity/Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for retrying a message that is no longer in the error state by the time the retry call resolves (e.g., state changed via another device or session)? [Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the account's very-first-ever message, where no session yet exists and the RAG-grounding context (User Story 1) has no prior entries at all to draw on? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is there a requirement for connectivity dropping and returning more than once while a single response is still streaming? [Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for cache staleness — if a cached session's history could diverge from the backend once connectivity returns, is a refresh required, or is the cache treated as authoritative until the user reopens the session? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the side menu's pagination requirement (FR-008) explicit about behavior when a cursor-paginated fetch fails mid-scroll (retry automatically, inline error, or silent stop)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK026 Is behavior specified for the app being backgrounded mid-stream and resumed — does the requirement rely solely on the existing "reflects whatever the backend ultimately recorded" rule (Edge Cases), or is a distinct resume/reconnect case needed? [Gap, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are performance expectations defined for the optimistic local message appearing after tap-to-send, distinct from the network-dependent streaming latency that follows it? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Plan Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK028 Are accessibility requirements (e.g., assistive-technology announcement of streaming → complete/error transitions) defined for chat message state changes? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for how the session-expiration overlay (FR-013) interacts with an in-progress SSE stream specifically, beyond the general "history and scroll position preserved" statement already covering static views? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption that "a session always has a `lastUserMessageAt` by the time it is listed" (Clarification 2) validated against the lazy-creation flow's actual ordering of session-creation and first-message-send calls? [Assumption, Spec Clarification 2]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the dependency on RF03/RF07's existing "Sessão expirada" overlay (FR-013) validated to already cover expiry occurring specifically mid-SSE-stream, not only during static history viewing? [Assumption, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the assumption that chat's write-call error presentation "follows the same retryable/non-retryable pattern already established project-wide (RNF09)" validated against SSE-specific failure modes, such as a stream erroring after partial tokens were already delivered? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK033 Does the spec bound how much or which prior content counts as "relevant" for grounding (User Story 1), or is relevance entirely opaque to the client with no observable contract? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK034 Does the spec clarify whether a response that found no relevant prior entries is client-distinguishable from a grounded one, given FR-001's "MUST be able to reflect" language implies grounding is not guaranteed on every response? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK035 Is "chat messages are conversational only" (FR-003) explicit about whether it excludes only entry-creation, or also other automatic side effects (e.g., analytics, proactive-insight triggers) not otherwise named in this unit's scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`

- Link to relevant resources or documentation
